visualCharacteristics.purpose: section heading and intro on the left with a ruled list of arrowed service links on the right

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: [heading + optional intro text | bulleted list of links]; an optional short plain-text paragraph right after the list (e.g. "Load more") becomes a toggle that reveals items beyond the first four

usage: Our Services / sub-service link lists on industry, office and service pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for heading-left, link-list-right overviews. For linked cards with descriptions use cards-service.
